QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults to off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). - `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` defaults to off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:2196`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros and describes them as gating macros: the mutexes only exist when MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is enabled, and the pthread spawn is gated by MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD.
